notes.title: [Update log] v1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Hello! Today we are bringing the v1.0.3 update. In this update patch we optimized graphics, UI and stage design, as well as fixed some bugs.

[Gameplay]
1. Re-design stage 5-7 because the stage could be solved too easily under previous design.
2. Fix a bug that characters would get stuck in place if they are on springboards and could not jump to any grids. Now they will go as if they are not on springboards.

[Graphics]
3. Optimize shadow quality throughout the game.

[UI]
4. Optimize the scrolls in the game. Mouse wheels now can be used to scroll among language options in the config menu.
5. Fix a bug that some texts flow out of the boxes in some cases.

[Localization]
6. Fix the translation of "Screen Resolution" in multiple languages.

notes.title: [Update log] v1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
We fixed some bugs in gameplay, graphics and UI in this update. Here are the contents of the update patch:

[Gameplay]
1. Fix a bug that stage 3-3 can be solved in a simple way.
2. Fix a bug that characters don't go into the portals in some cases. (which make stage 3-5 very easy to solve)
3. Fix a bug that stage 3-8 can be solved in a simple way.
4. Fix a bug that stage 3-9 can be solved in a simple way.

[Graphics]
5. Fix a bug that door keys do not display correctly on Mac.

[UI]
6. Fix a bug that the game gets white screen when trying to return to menu after a stage is completed.
7. Fix a bug that Suomalainen(Finnish) could not be selected as the game language.

Wish you enjoy the game! If you have any suggestions or bugs to report, please don't hesitate to send email to bestqgame@gmail.com or bestqgame@163.com!

notes.title: [Update log] v1.0.1 Release Day Update
notes.content:
Today is the release day of Hero Guider! Hope you all enjoy the game!

We post this update to fix some bugs:
1. Fix a bug that stage2-9 can be solved in a simple way.
2. Fix a bug that characters keep moving motion after the stage is completed.
